title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：variation　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 variation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the observer ① noted the variation that no assistant in the observatory would have described, and he said the noting was the whole of the night. The ② variation, meaning the change itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; a variation, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ variation in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ variation at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A variation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the observer said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the variation was the whole of the matter, meaning the variety and not the change. The ⑥ variation, meaning the variety and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; variation, he said, is either something you note or the only word that means both a change and a variety. He said the variety is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ variation had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ variation of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of describing; variation, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ variation I remember is the change described in the log, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the observatory. A ⑩ variation, my mother said in 1980, is the only change that improves by being described; every variation, she said, is a variety that has agreed to look like a change. She said the variety was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 变化；变体（指观测站里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 变化；变体（指那种变化本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：note the variation 记录这一种变化
D. n. 变化；变体（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 变化之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的变化之事）
F. n. 变化；变体（指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一种）
G. n. 变化、多样（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 多样（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: noted the variation that no assistant in the observatory would have described
The variation, meaning the change itself and not the lens
the variation at the far dome
the variation was the whole of the matter
the variation had become a line in a log
The variation of the whole thing
A variation, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: note the variation 意为“记录这一种变化”，1971 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯描述的一种变化做了一遍。
variation 意为“变化；变体”，指那种变化本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
variation 意为“变化；变体”，指观测站里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
variation 意为“变化；变体”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
variation 意为“变化、多样”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种多样就是那件事的全部。
variation 意为“多样”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种变化，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
variation 意为“变化；变体”，指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一种，到 1976 年这一种成了观测记录里的一行。
variation 意为“变化之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的变化之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的描述。
variation 意为“变化；变体”，我记得的是观测记录里描述过的那一种，1978 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一种。
variation 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，变化是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的变化。

那种变化，指的是那种变化本身而不是小小的镜片，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。（variation）
那处观测站里每一种变化旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。（variation）
